cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
s: Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer is a one-component water dispersed adhesion promoting primer for water dispersed polymer paint coatings.
Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer is part of a system that complies with the requirements of EN 1504-2 as a protective coating.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Uses
cl.l: Priming coat for concrete and dense mineral substrates like fibre cement, aerated concrete, gypsum and thin rendering such as Sika® MonoTop®-723 N, Monotop FC, etc. Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer can also be used as a primer on firmly adhering existing water based coatings or under cement resurfacing mortar to improve the adhesion in case of concrete surface treated with hydrophobic impregnation. Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer is part of a system:
s: Suitable for protection against ingress (Principle 1, method 1.3 of EN 1504-9),
Suitable for moisture control (Principle 2, method 2.3 of EN 1504-9)
Suitable for increasing the resistivity (Principle 8, method 8.3 of EN 1504-9)

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality / Pre-Treatment
s: The substrate must be dense and free from loose and friable particles.
Tensile strength of the substrate must be more than 1 N/mm².

cl.t: Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Exposed concrete without existing coating
cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality / Pre-Treatment > Exposed concrete without existing coating
cl.x: Suitable preparation methods are steam cleaning, high pressure water jetting or blastcleaning. New concrete must be at least 28 days old.

cl.t: Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Thin layer renderings
cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality / Pre-Treatment > Thin layer renderings
cl.x: If required, a levelling pore sealer (e.g. Sika® Mono-Top®-723 N, Sika® MonoTop®- FC, Sikagard®-550 W , etc.) shall be applied – refer to the respective product data sheet. For cement based products, allow a curing time of at least 4 days before priming.

cl.t: Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Exposed concrete with existing coating
cl.c: Data sheet pages 2-3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality / Pre-Treatment > Exposed concrete with existing coating
cl.l: Existing coatings must be tested to confirm their adhesion to the substrate - adhesion test average: > 1.0 N/mm² with no single value below 0.7 N/mm2 for subsequent top rigid coating; > 0.8 N/mm² with no single value below 0.5 N/mm² for subsequent top elastic coating respectively – refer to the relevant Method Statement for more details.
s: For water based coating, use Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer as primer
For solvent based coating, use Sikagard®-551 S Elastic Primer - refer to separate data sheet
In case of doubt, carry out adherence testing to determine which primer is most suitable - wait at least 2 weeks after application prior to conduct the adhesion test as per EN 1542

cl.x: Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information
s: Consumption: ~0.10–0.12 kg/m² (~8–10 m² per litre) dependent on the absorbency of the substrate.
r: ~0.10–0.12 kg/m² (~8–10 m² per litre) dependent on the absorbency of the substrate.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Waiting time to overcoating
tr: Note: When application is on existing coating, waiting time prior to overcoat the primer will increase by 100%.
Use only water dispersed coating systems on top of Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer.
When used as primer under cement based resurfacing mortar, apply the mortar when the primer is still tacky. If the primer has dried out completely, re-apply 1 coat

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application
s: Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer is supplied ready for use; do not dilute it. Shake it thoroughly prior to apply it.
Sikagard®-552 W Aquaprimer can be applied by brush, roller or airless spray.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
cl.x: Clean all tools and application equipment with clean water immediately after use. Hardened / cured material can only be removed mechanically.
